repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: Clash Verge Rev 是基于 Tauri 2 和 Rust 构建的现代化 Clash.Meta 客户端，支持跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），提供简洁美观的 GUI 界面、配置文件管理、TUN 模式、WebDav 同步及自定义主题，适用于高性能代理需求。
repos.summary_en: Clash Verge Rev is a modern GUI client for Clash.Meta (mihomo) built with Tauri 2 and Rust, offering cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux), intuitive UI, config management, TUN mode, WebDav sync, and customizable themes for advanced proxy control.

repos.description: Display and control your Android device
repos.summary_zh: scrcpy 是一款高性能、低延迟的 Android 设备屏幕镜像与控制工具，支持 USB/TCP 连接，无需 root 或额外应用。具备 30~120fps 流畅传输、1920×1080 高清画质、35~70ms 低延迟、1 秒内启动等特性，并提供音频转发、录制、虚拟显示、键盘鼠标模拟、游戏手柄支持等丰富功能，适用于 Linux、Windows、macOS 三大平台。
repos.summary_en: scrcpy is a lightweight, high-performance Android device mirroring and control tool that supports USB/TCP connections without requiring root access or additional apps. It delivers 30~120fps video at 1920×1080+ quality with 35~70ms latency and sub-second startup. Features include audio forwarding, recording, virtual display, HID keyboard/mouse simulation, gamepad support, and more, available on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

repos.description:  Now we have become very big, Different from the original idea. Collect premium software in various categories.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Mac 是一个精选 macOS 优质软件的资源库，涵盖开发工具、设计软件、效率应用等多个类别。项目规模庞大，支持多语言（含中文、韩文），并提供 Docker 镜像和 npm 包形式发布。包含开源、免费、App Store 应用等标签分类，鼓励用户贡献与反馈。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Mac is a curated collection of premium macOS software across categories like development tools, design apps, and productivity utilities. It features a vast scale, multilingual support (including Chinese and Korean), and is available via Docker and npm. The list categorizes apps by open-source, freeware, and App Store status, encouraging community contributions.

repos.description: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.
repos.summary_zh: NextChat 是一款轻量级、高性能的 AI 助手应用，支持 Web、iOS、macOS、Android、Linux 和 Windows 全平台。它集成了 Claude、DeepSeek、GPT-4 和 Gemini Pro 等多种 AI 模型，提供现代化的用户界面和强大的功能，包括 MCP 支持、企业级私有化部署、知识库集成和权限管理，适用于个人用户和企业客户。
repos.summary_en: NextChat is a lightweight and fast AI assistant supporting Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, and Windows. It integrates multiple AI models including Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, and Gemini Pro. Featuring modern UI, MCP support, enterprise-grade private deployment, knowledge base integration, and admin panel with permission controls.

repos.description: Bring projects, wikis, and teams together with AI. AppFlowy is the AI collaborative workspace where you achieve more without losing control of your data. The leading open source Notion alternative.
repos.summary_zh: AppFlowy 是一款开源的 AI 协作文档工具，作为 Notion 的替代方案，支持项目、维基与团队协作。基于 Flutter 和 Rust 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端应用，具备数据库、看板、文档及 AI 助手功能，强调数据自主控制与隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: AppFlowy is an open-source AI-powered collaborative workspace and Notion alternative, enabling projects, wikis, and team collaboration. Built with Flutter and Rust, it offers cross-platform desktop and mobile apps with databases, kanban boards, docs, and AI assistance, prioritizing data ownership and privacy.

repos.description: 🐹 Open-source Mac and PC cleaner. Keep your machine clean, light, and running like new. Fast CLI, plus native Mac and Windows apps.
repos.summary_zh: Mole 是一款 macOS 深度清理优化工具，集成 CleanMyMac、AppCleaner 等工具功能于一身。支持深度清理缓存日志、智能卸载应用及其残留文件、可视化磁盘分析、实时系统监控，并提供一键优化系统服务。通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装，提供交互式菜单与命令行操作，支持预览清理计划、白名单管理及详细调试日志，兼顾高效性与安全性。
repos.summary_en: Mole is a comprehensive macOS optimization tool combining features of CleanMyMac, AppCleaner, DaisyDisk, and iStat Menus. It enables deep cleaning of caches/logs, smart app uninstallation with leftover removal, visual disk analysis, real-time system monitoring, and system service optimization. Installed via Homebrew or script, it offers interactive menus and CLI commands with dry-run previews, whitelist management, and detailed debug logging for safe and efficient system maintenance.

repos.description: Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with one command, on macOS, Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Pake 是一个基于 Rust Tauri 框架的网页转桌面应用工具，支持一键将任意网页打包为跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）原生应用。核心优势包括体积小巧（仅约5MB）、启动迅速、零配置快速部署，并提供广告过滤、沉浸式模式、快捷键等丰富功能，极大提升网页应用的使用体验。
repos.summary_en: Pake is a lightweight tool that converts any webpage into a desktop app with one command, built on Rust Tauri for cross-platform support (macOS, Windows, Linux). It offers ultra-small size (~5MB), fast startup, zero-configuration packaging, and features like ad-blocking, immersive mode, and customizable shortcuts for enhanced web app usability.

repos.description: An awesome list that curates the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, articles and more.
repos.summary_zh: Solido/awesome-flutter 是一个精选的 Flutter 资源库，涵盖最佳库、工具、教程、文章等，为开发者提供全面的 Flutter 开发指南，助力跨平台应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Solido/awesome-flutter is a curated list of the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, and articles, serving as a comprehensive resource for Flutter developers to build cross-platform applications.

repos.description: Odoo. Open Source Apps To Grow Your Business.
repos.summary_zh: Odoo 是一套基于开源技术的企业级业务应用套件，涵盖 CRM、电商、仓储、财务、项目管理等核心模块，支持模块化部署与无缝集成，提供完整的开源 ERP 解决方案。其低代码平台与 Python 技术栈便于二次开发，适用于中小企业数字化转型。
repos.summary_en: Odoo is an open-source business application suite featuring integrated modules like CRM, eCommerce, accounting, and inventory management. Built on Python, it offers modular, scalable ERP solutions with seamless integration and extensive customization capabilities for growing businesses.

repos.description: 🚀 Awesome list of open source applications for macOS. https://t.me/s/opensourcemacosapps
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是 macOS 开源应用精选列表，收录 689 款高质量开源应用，涵盖音频、开发、图形、生产力等 49 个类别。以 Swift 为主力语言，支持跨平台与原生应用，旨在帮助用户发现优质免费工具并鼓励社区贡献。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 689 open source macOS applications across 49 categories, including audio, development, graphics, and productivity. Primarily written in Swift, it features both native and cross-platform apps to help users discover free tools and encourages community contributions.

repos.description: Build your personal knowledge base with Trilium Notes
repos.summary_zh: Trilium Notes 是一款免费开源的跨平台笔记应用，支持构建大型个人知识库。其核心功能包括无限层级树状结构、富文本与 Markdown 编辑器、代码高亮、全文搜索、版本控制及多位置克隆笔记，适用于知识管理与结构化信息存储。
repos.summary_en: Trilium Notes is a free, open-source, cross-platform note-taking app focused on building large personal knowledge bases. It features hierarchical notes with cloning support, rich WYSIWYG editing (including math and code syntax highlighting), full-text search, versioning, and seamless navigation.

repos.description: 我的电视 电视直播软件，安装即可使用
repos.summary_zh: 我的电视是一款专为智能电视和盒子设计的直播软件，支持U盘安装、ADB部署及小米电视助手安装，提供即装即用的电视直播服务。具备频道收藏、多平台适配等基础功能，适用于Android设备，但部分老旧机型存在兼容性问题。
repos.summary_en: My TV is a ready-to-use live streaming app for smart TVs and Android boxes, supporting USB installation, ADB deployment, and Mi TV Assistant. It offers basic features like channel favorites and multi-platform compatibility, though some legacy devices may face instability or incompatibility issues.

repos.description: A UI library by WeChat official design team, includes the most useful widgets/modules in mobile web applications.
repos.summary_zh: WeUI 是腾讯微信官方设计团队打造的开源 UI 库，专为微信小程序和 Web 应用设计，提供丰富的移动端组件（如按钮、表单、弹窗等），确保与微信生态一致的用户体验，支持快速构建美观、标准化的移动 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: WeUI is an open-source UI library developed by Tencent's WeChat design team, specifically tailored for WeChat web and mini-program development. It offers a comprehensive set of mobile-first components (e.g., buttons, forms, dialogs) to deliver a consistent and standardized user experience across WeChat ecosystems, enabling rapid development of visually appealing mobile web apps.

repos.description: Multi-platform auto-proxy client, supporting Sing-box, X-ray, TUIC, Hysteria, Reality, Trojan, SSH etc. It’s an open-source, secure and ad-free.
repos.summary_zh: Hiddify 是一款跨平台代理客户端，基于 Sing-box 构建，支持 Vless、Vmess、Reality、TUIC、Hysteria、WireGuard、SSH 等多种协议。具备自动节点选择、TUN 模式、远程配置同步等功能，界面简洁、无广告、开源安全，支持多语言及深色/浅色主题，适用于 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
repos.summary_en: Hiddify is a multi-platform proxy client built on Sing-box, supporting Vless, Vmess, Reality, TUIC, Hysteria, WireGuard, SSH, and more. It features automatic node selection, TUN mode, remote configuration sync, and an intuitive UI. Open-source, ad-free, and secure, it's available on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.

repos.description: 基于 ChatGPT API 的划词翻译浏览器插件和跨平台桌面端应用    -    Browser extension and cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 ChatGPT API 的智能划词翻译工具，支持浏览器插件和跨平台桌面应用。提供翻译、润色、摘要三大功能，覆盖55种语言互译，支持流式响应、文本朗读、截图翻译及多LLM平台接入（OpenAI/Azure/MiniMax），具备词汇本管理和记忆辅助生成能力。
repos.summary_en: An intelligent word-selection translator powered by ChatGPT API, available as both a browser extension and cross-platform desktop app. Offers translation, polishing, and summarization across 55 languages, with streaming support, TTS, screenshot translation, vocabulary books, and multi-LLM provider integration (OpenAI/Azure/MiniMax).

repos.description: An Open Source YouTube app for privacy
repos.summary_zh: FreeTube 是一款注重隐私的开源桌面 YouTube 播放器，基于 Electron 跨平台运行。它通过内置提取器和 Invidious API 绕过官方接口获取视频数据，避免使用 Google 的 cookies 和 JavaScript 追踪用户行为，所有订阅、播放列表和历史记录均本地存储。支持无广告观看、频道订阅无需登录、代理连接（如 Tor）及多配置文件管理，为用户提供去中心化、反追踪的 YouTube 体验。
repos.summary_en: FreeTube is an open-source desktop YouTube player built with privacy in mind, using Electron for cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux). It bypasses official APIs via a built-in extractor or optional Invidious API to deliver ad-free videos without Google tracking through cookies or JavaScript. All data—subscriptions, playlists, and history—is stored locally. Features include anonymous channel subscriptions, proxy integration (e.g., Tor), profile-based feed organization, and full offline access to personalized content.

repos.description: 🐱 跨平台互动桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
repos.summary_zh: BongoCat 是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，基于 Tauri 框架开发，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统。它以可爱的猫咪形象提供桌面陪伴功能，用户可通过点击、拖拽等交互触发趣味动画，为日常办公增添轻松娱乐元素。
repos.summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet built with Tauri, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a playful cat character that responds to user interactions like clicks and drags with animated effects, adding entertainment to your desktop experience.

repos.description: React Native指南汇集了各类react-native学习资源、开源App和组件
repos.summary_zh: React Native学习指南是一个全面的中文资源库，汇集了React Native开发教程、开源APP案例、组件库、工具链及权威文档，覆盖从入门到原生模块开发的完整技术栈，助力开发者快速构建跨平台移动应用。
repos.summary_en: The React Native Learning Guide is a comprehensive Chinese resource hub compiling tutorials, open-source apps, components, tools, and official documentation for React Native development, covering everything from beginner guides to native module integration for cross-platform mobile app creation.

repos.description: Mobile UI Components based on Vue & WeUI
repos.summary_zh: Vux 是基于 Vue 2.3+ 和 WeUI 构建的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的微信风格组件与交互效果。支持 webpack 构建，集成数据绑定与事件处理，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用，兼容主流移动浏览器。
repos.summary_en: Vux is a mobile UI component library built on Vue 2.3+ and WeUI, offering rich WeChat-style components and interactions. It supports webpack build, data binding, and event handling, ideal for rapid mobile web app development with broad browser compatibility.

repos.description: 收集&推荐优秀的 Apps/硬件/技巧/周边等
repos.summary_zh: Best App 是一个精选优质应用、硬件及生活技巧的推荐项目，涵盖 macOS、iOS、Android 等平台。聚焦付费与免费精品应用，提供详细功能介绍与横向测评，帮助用户高效选择提升效率与幸福感的工具。项目强调客观推荐，拒绝广告与捐赠，倡导有章可循的产品选择。
repos.summary_en: Best App is a curated collection of excellent apps, hardware, and life-enhancing tips across macOS, iOS, and Android. It features detailed reviews and comparisons of premium and free apps, helping users make informed choices for productivity and lifestyle improvement. The project maintains objectivity, avoids ads, and encourages community contributions via Star or Pull Request.

repos.description: Open source Loom alternative. Beautiful, shareable screen recordings.
repos.summary_zh: Cap 是一款开源的 Loom 替代工具，提供美观、可分享的屏幕录制功能。支持视频录制、编辑与快速分享，采用 Rust + Tauri 构建桌面端，Next.js + React 开发 Web 端，基于 MySQL 和 Drizzle ORM，支持 Docker 一键部署与自托管。
repos.summary_en: Cap is an open-source alternative to Loom, offering beautiful, shareable screen recordings. It enables quick video recording, editing, and sharing via a desktop app (Tauri/Rust) and web interface (Next.js/React), with MySQL backend, Docker deployment, and self-hosting support.

repos.description: This repository is outdated and new Boost Note app is available! We've launched a new Boost Note app which supports real-time collaborative writing. https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote-App
repos.summary_zh: BoostNote-Legacy 是一款面向程序员的开源笔记应用，支持多平台（Mac、Windows、Linux）。该仓库已标记为过时，推荐使用支持实时协作的新版 BoostNote 应用，其基于 Electron、React + Redux 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端支持。
repos.summary_en: BoostNote-Legacy is an open-source note-taking app designed for programmers, supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. This repository is deprecated; users are advised to migrate to the new BoostNote app, which features real-time collaborative writing and is built with Electron, React + Redux.

repos.description: Mobile UI elements for Vue.js
repos.summary_zh: Mint UI 是一个专为 Vue 2.0 设计的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的移动端常用组件，支持全局注册和按需引入，具备轻量、模块化、易集成的特点，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: Mint UI is a mobile-first UI component library for Vue 2.0, offering a suite of mobile-optimized components. It supports global registration and modular imports, with features like lightweight design, modularity, and easy integration, ideal for rapid mobile web development.

repos.description: 一个第三方音乐播放器、本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载、远程控制
repos.summary_zh: AlgerMusicPlayer 是一款功能强大的第三方跨平台音乐播放器，支持网易云账号登录、本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载及远程控制。基于 Electron 和 Vue 开发，提供沉浸式歌词显示、EQ均衡器、多语言界面和明暗主题切换，支持全平台运行（桌面/Web/移动端），兼顾高品质音质与个性化体验。
repos.summary_en: AlgerMusicPlayer is a powerful third-party cross-platform music player supporting NetEase Cloud login, local services, desktop lyrics, music downloads, and remote control. Built with Electron and Vue, it offers immersive lyrics, EQ equalizer, multi-language UI, dark/light themes, and high-fidelity audio, running on Desktop, Web, and Mobile platforms with personalized features.

repos.description: :speech_balloon: A better WeChat on macOS and Linux. Built with Electron by Zhongyi Tong.
repos.summary_zh: Electronic WeChat 是一款基于 Electron 开发的跨平台微信客户端，专为 macOS 和 Linux 设计。它复刻了网页版微信的所有功能，包括消息撤回拦截、表情包支持、拖拽发送图片等，并优化了原生应用体验。项目已停止维护，但作为 Electron 桌面应用开发的优秀范例仍具参考价值。
repos.summary_en: Electronic WeChat is an Electron-based cross-platform WeChat client for macOS and Linux, replicating all Web WeChat features including message recall blocking and sticker support. It offers native-like experience with optimizations like direct URL access and drag-and-drop file sharing. Though discontinued, it serves as an excellent reference for Electron desktop app development.

repos.description: :speech_balloon: A better WeChat on macOS and Linux. Built with Electron by Zhongyi Tong.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Electron 开发的跨平台微信客户端，支持 macOS 和 Linux，提供现代化界面和完整 Web 微信功能，包括消息撤回拦截、贴图支持、文件拖拽发送等。项目已停止维护，作为技术存档供学习参考。
repos.summary_en: An Electron-based cross-platform WeChat client for macOS and Linux, featuring modern UI, full Web WeChat functionality, message recall blocking, sticker support, and drag-and-drop file sharing. The project is archived and no longer actively maintained.

repos.description: 微信《跳一跳》Python 辅助
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一个基于 Python 的微信小游戏《跳一跳》自动化辅助工具，通过图像识别技术自动识别棋子位置与目标方块，结合 ADB 控制手机屏幕实现精准跳跃。支持手动校准与自动识别两种模式，利用像素距离计算按压时长，帮助用户高效刷分登顶排行榜。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Python-based automation tool for WeChat's mini-game 'Jump Jump'. It uses image recognition to detect the player's position and target blocks, calculates the required press duration based on pixel distance, and controls the screen via ADB to achieve precise jumps, enabling automatic high-score gameplay.

repos.description: 最接近原生APP体验的高性能框架
repos.summary_zh: mui 是一个专为移动端 HTML5 应用设计的高性能框架，有效解决了浏览器原生体验差的问题，如白屏、动画卡顿、下拉刷新不流畅等。它提供接近原生 APP 的流畅交互与丰富 UI 控件，支持与 HBuilder 开发工具深度集成，显著提升移动端 Web 应用开发效率与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: mui is a high-performance framework for mobile HTML5 apps, addressing core issues like page flickering, poor animations, and unsmooth pull-to-refresh. It delivers near-native app experiences with rich UI components and seamless integration with HBuilder, enabling efficient development of smooth, visually appealing mobile web applications.

repos.description: Automation&Workflow JavaScript IDE on Android(安卓平台上的JavaScript编程IDE)
repos.summary_zh: Auto.js (Pro) 是一款专为 Android 设计的 JavaScript IDE，专注于编程学习与效率提升，支持自动化脚本开发与工作流管理，提供丰富的 API 和可视化工具，适用于移动端自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Auto.js (Pro) is a JavaScript-based IDE for Android, designed for programming education and productivity enhancement. It enables automation scripting and workflow management with rich APIs and visual tools, ideal for mobile automation tasks.

repos.description: Clash Nyanpasu～(∠・ω< )⌒☆​
repos.summary_zh: Clash Nyanpasu 是一款基于 Tauri 框架的 Clash 网络代理图形界面客户端，支持 Clash Premium、Mihomo 和 Clash Rust 内核。提供多配置文件和 Provider 管理功能，采用 Google Material You 设计语言，具备深色/浅色主题切换，支持跨平台运行。
repos.summary_en: Clash Nyanpasu is a Tauri-based GUI client for Clash network proxy, supporting Clash Premium, Mihomo, and Clash Rust cores. It offers profile and provider management with Google Material You UI design, dark/light themes, and cross-platform support.

repos.description: A powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, which supports global settings, Interceptors, FormData, aborting and canceling a request, files uploading and downloading, requests timeout, custom adapters, etc.
repos.summary_zh: dio 是一个强大的 Dart 和 Flutter HTTP 客户端库，支持全局配置、拦截器、FormData、请求取消、文件上传下载、超时控制及自定义适配器。提供完整的 REST API 调用能力，适用于移动端和 Web 应用开发，具备高度可定制性和跨平台兼容性。
repos.summary_en: dio is a powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, supporting global settings, interceptors, FormData, request cancellation, file uploads/downloads, timeouts, and custom adapters. It offers full REST API capabilities with high customization and cross-platform compatibility for mobile and web apps.

repos.description: Essential UI blocks for building mobile web apps.
repos.summary_zh: Ant Design Mobile 是构建移动端 Web 应用的核心 UI 组件库，提供高性能、可定制的原子化组件，支持 CSS 变量主题定制与流畅动画，适用于快速开发跨平台移动应用。
repos.summary_en: Ant Design Mobile is a core UI component library for building mobile web apps, offering high-performance, customizable atomic components with CSS variable theming and smooth animations for cross-platform mobile development.

repos.description: Not Just A Notepad! (golang + mongodb) http://leanote.org
repos.summary_zh: Leanote 是一款功能强大的开源笔记应用，采用 Go 语言和 MongoDB 构建，提供富文本和 Markdown 编辑器，支持 Vim/Emacs 编辑模式、知识管理、协作分享及博客发布。它弥补了 Evernote 在代码高亮、实时渲染、跨平台支持等方面的不足，适合个人与团队知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Leanote is a powerful open-source note-taking app built with Go and MongoDB, featuring rich-text and Markdown editors, Vim/Emacs modes, knowledge management, collaboration, and blogging. It addresses Evernote's limitations in code syntax highlighting, real-time rendering, and cross-platform support, ideal for personal and team knowledge management.

repos.description: Android官方培训课程中文版
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是 Google Android 官方培训课程《Android Training》的中文协作翻译版本，涵盖 Android 应用开发核心知识体系，由社区开发者共同维护。提供在线阅读与在线编辑功能，支持纠错与内容完善，是学习 Android 开发的优质中文资源。
repos.summary_en: This project is the Chinese translation of Google's official Android Training course, collaboratively translated by the community. It covers core Android development topics, offering online reading and editing support for corrections and improvements, serving as a valuable Chinese resource for Android developers.

repos.description: ✍️ A static blog writing client (一个静态博客写作客户端)
repos.summary_zh: Gridea 是一款跨平台静态博客写作客户端，支持 Markdown 编辑、多语言界面、主题定制及 Gitalk/DisqusJS 评论系统。用户可本地创作并一键发布至 GitHub Pages 等平台，集成 OneDrive/iCloud 实现多设备同步，适合个人知识管理与内容创作。
repos.summary_en: Gridea is a cross-platform static blog writing client that supports Markdown editing, multi-language interface, theme customization, and Gitalk/DisqusJS comment systems. It enables local content creation with one-click publishing to platforms like GitHub Pages, featuring OneDrive/iCloud sync for multi-device workflows, ideal for personal knowledge management and content creation.

repos.description: 网易云音乐第三方
repos.summary_zh: ieaseMusic 是一款基于 Electron、React 和 MobX 构建的优雅网易云音乐第三方桌面客户端，支持跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows）、高音质（FLAC）、键盘操作、桌面通知、Last.fm 听歌记录同步、多平台音源修复（如 QQ 音乐、虾米等）、社交分享及微信扫码登录，集成 Alfred 3 工作流，提供现代化 UI 与下载功能。
repos.summary_en: ieaseMusic is an elegant third-party Netease Music desktop app built with Electron, React, and MobX. It supports cross-platform use (macOS/Linux/Windows), high-quality FLAC audio, keyboard shortcuts, desktop notifications, Last.fm scrobbling, multi-source link fixing (e.g., QQ, Xiami), social sharing, WeChat login, and includes an Alfred 3 workflow for quick access.

repos.description: 收集整理Android开发所需的Android SDK、开发中用到的工具、Android开发教程、Android设计规范，免费的设计素材等。
repos.summary_zh: AndroidDevTools 是一个专注于 Android 开发的一站式资源平台，提供 Android SDK、开发工具、设计规范、教程及素材的整合。涵盖从开发环境搭建、代码生成、资源处理到设计协作的全流程工具链，支持 Android Studio、Gradle 等主流技术栈，助力开发者高效构建高质量应用。
repos.summary_en: AndroidDevTools is a comprehensive platform for Android developers, offering curated resources including Android SDK, development tools, design guidelines, tutorials, and free assets. It covers the full development lifecycle—from environment setup and code generation to resource optimization and UI design—supporting major tools like Android Studio and Gradle to enhance productivity.

repos.description: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 智能体技能，支持 15+ 主流开发工具（如 Cursor、Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等）。通过中央仓库集中管理技能，支持从 Git 仓库、本地文件或市场导入，一键同步至目标工具，并提供场景分组、更新追踪和技能文档预览功能。
repos.summary_en: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app that centralizes the management, sync, and organization of AI agent skills across 15+ coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot. It supports importing skills from Git repos, local folders, or the marketplace into a unified repository, enables one-click sync via symlinks/copies, and offers scenario grouping, update tracking, and in-app skill documentation preview.

repos.description: 30 days of React Native demos
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是30天React Native实战教程，涵盖从基础组件到高级动画、手势识别、地图定位、生物识别等22个完整案例，包含iOS原生级交互效果，适合移动端开发学习者系统掌握React Native核心技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a 30-day React Native tutorial series featuring 22 complete demos, covering core components, animations, gestures, maps, biometric authentication, and more. It provides hands-on experience with iOS-level interactions for mobile development learners.

repos.description: Flutter Launch Timeline Demo
repos.summary_zh: 该应用是一个基于 Flutter 开发的交互式时间轴应用，展示从宇宙大爆炸到互联网诞生的历史事件。通过精美的动画和垂直滚动时间轴，用户可探索不同时代的关键事件，每个事件配有动态气泡和详细文章页面。核心技术包括 Flutter 框架、Flare 和 Nima 动画库，以及自定义 LeafRenderObjectWidget 实现高性能渲染。
repos.summary_en: This is an interactive vertical timeline app built with Flutter, showcasing historical events from the Big Bang to the Internet. It features animated event bubbles, detailed article pages, and smooth scrolling/zooming. Built using Flutter with Flare and Nima animation libraries, plus custom LeafRenderObjectWidget for high-performance rendering.

repos.description: A collection of MCP clients.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome MCP Clients 是一个精心策划的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 客户端集合，涵盖 CLI、桌面应用、AI 助手等多种类型，支持跨平台运行，旨在扩展 AI 模型对本地和远程资源的访问能力，提升智能交互体验。
repos.summary_en: Awesome MCP Clients is a curated collection of Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, including CLI tools, desktop apps, and AI assistants, supporting cross-platform use to extend AI models' access to local and remote resources for enhanced intelligent interaction.

repos.description: "Sigma File Manager" is a free, open-source, quickly evolving, modern file manager (explorer / browser) app for Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Sigma File Manager 是一款免费开源的现代文件管理器，专为 Windows 和 Linux 设计，支持快速文件浏览与操作。项目已进入 v2 稳定测试阶段，提供直观界面与高效功能，适用于日常文件管理需求。
repos.summary_en: Sigma File Manager is a free, open-source, modern file manager for Windows and Linux, offering fast file browsing and operations. Now in v2 beta, it features an intuitive interface and efficient tools for streamlined file management.

repos.description: Making AJAX as easy as anchor tags
repos.summary_zh: Intercooler 是一个轻量级（6.74KB gzipped）的 AJAX 增强库，通过 HTML 属性即可实现类似锚标签的异步交互。它支持事件触发、进度指示、RESTful 依赖、AJAX 历史记录等功能，无需编写 JavaScript 即可构建现代 Web 应用，适用于渐进式增强现有项目。
repos.summary_en: Intercooler is a lightweight (6.74KB gzipped) library that enables AJAX functionality using HTML attributes, similar to anchor tags. It supports event triggers, progress indicators, RESTful dependencies, AJAX history, and more, allowing developers to build modern web apps with minimal JavaScript, ideal for incremental enhancement of existing applications.

repos.description: A lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features.
repos.summary_zh: ezBookkeeping 是一款轻量级自托管个人财务管理应用，支持 Docker 快速部署，具备用户友好的界面和强大的记账功能。支持多语言、多币种、AI 收据识别、数据导入导出（CSV/OFX/QFX 等），并提供图表分析、地理位置标记、双因素认证等高级特性，适用于 Raspberry Pi、NAS 等低资源设备。
repos.summary_en: ezBookkeeping is a lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features. It supports Docker deployment, multi-language/currency, AI receipt recognition, data import/export (CSV/OFX/QFX), chart analytics, location tagging, and 2FA, optimized for low-resource devices like Raspberry Pi and NAS.

repos.description: 🍒 This is the mobile version of Cherry Studio.
repos.summary_zh: Cherry Studio App 是 Cherry Studio 的官方移动端应用，专为 iOS 和 Android 设计，提供多 LLM 提供商支持（OpenAI、Gemini 等）、AI 助手对话、深色/浅色主题适配及本地数据管理功能，采用 Expo React Native + Redux Toolkit 架构。
repos.summary_en: Cherry Studio App is the official mobile version of Cherry Studio, optimized for iOS and Android. It supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini), AI assistant conversations, dark/light themes, and local data management, built with Expo React Native and Redux Toolkit.

repos.description: React Native入门指南
repos.summary_zh: React Native入门指南，系统讲解从环境搭建到组件开发的全流程，涵盖JSX语法、布局设计、UI组件使用及与原生代码集成，适合初学者快速掌握移动端跨平台开发技能。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive React Native tutorial covering fundamentals like JSX, layout design, UI components, and native module integration, designed for developers to master cross-platform mobile app development efficiently.

repos.description: A desktop GUI for Claude Code — chat, code, and manage projects visually. Built with Electron + Next.js.
repos.summary_zh: CodePilot 是一个基于 Electron + Next.js 构建的 Claude Code 桌面 GUI 客户端，提供多模型提供商支持、MCP 扩展、自定义技能、跨平台通信及项目感知型智能助手工作区，实现可视化聊天、编码与项目管理一体化体验。
repos.summary_en: CodePilot is a desktop GUI client for Claude Code built with Electron and Next.js, offering multi-provider support, MCP extensions, custom skills, cross-platform bridging, and an AI assistant workspace that understands your projects through persistent memory and onboarding flows.

repos.description: Multi-agent AI orchestration platform for automation, workflows, and developer tools. Golutra transforms Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw into a unified agent system with parallel execution, task orchestration, long-running workflows, and AI productivity workspace.
repos.summary_zh: golutra 是一款下一代多智能体协作工作台，将现有 CLI 工具转化为统一的 AI 协作枢纽。支持无限并行执行、自动化编排和实时结果跟踪，无需迁移项目或重学命令。基于 Vue 3 + Rust 的 Tauri 桌面应用，兼容 Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等主流 AI 工具，实现‘一人+AI团队’的高效开发模式，适用于软件开发、内容创作等多种场景。
repos.summary_en: golutra is a next-generation multi-agent workspace that transforms existing CLI tools into a unified AI collaboration hub. It supports unlimited parallel execution, automated orchestration, and real-time tracking without project migration or command relearning. Built with Vue 3 + Rust as a Tauri desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux, it integrates with AI agents like Claude Code and Gemini CLI to enable efficient 'one person + an AI squad' workflows across software development and content creation.

repos.description: Legacy code of V2EX running on Google App Engine
repos.summary_zh: Project Babel 2 是基于 Python 和 Google App Engine 的开源社区建站系统，专为构建类似 V2EX 的分享与发现型社区设计。支持节点分类、多主题管理、响应式主题、WebDAV 头像托管、Atom 订阅、HTML5 兼容、MapReduce 数据优化及 Twitter OAuth 集成，具备高性能扩展能力，支持百万级日访问量。
repos.summary_en: Project Babel 2 is an open-source community platform built with Python on Google App Engine, designed for sharing and discovery communities like V2EX. It features node-based organization, responsive themes, WebDAV avatars, Atom feeds, HTML5 support, MapReduce data optimization, and Twitter OAuth integration, capable of scaling to millions of daily pageviews with proper configuration.

repos.description: macOS Adobe apps download & installer
repos.summary_zh: Adobe Downloader 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 Adobe 应用程序下载与安装工具，支持多产品并行下载、版本与语言选择，并集成自动化安装与清理功能。通过内置 Helper 机制实现免密操作，无需用户干预即可完成 Setup 组件修改，确保合法官方渠道下载，适用于专业创意软件部署。
repos.summary_en: Adobe Downloader is a macOS-native tool for downloading and installing Adobe applications. It supports parallel downloads, version/language selection, and automated installation via a built-in Helper mechanism that eliminates password prompts. All downloads are from official Adobe sources, with full cleanup utilities for residual files, ideal for enterprise or personal use.

repos.description: A command line tool for upgrading every outdated app installed by Homebrew Cask
repos.summary_zh: brew-cask-upgrade 是一个命令行工具，用于升级通过 Homebrew Cask 安装的过时 macOS GUI 应用。它提供交互式界面、细粒度控制及自动更新检测，支持批量升级、排除自动更新应用、清理缓存等功能，是 Homebrew Cask 生态中提升应用管理效率的关键工具。
repos.summary_en: brew-cask-upgrade is a CLI tool to upgrade outdated macOS GUI apps installed via Homebrew Cask. It offers interactive prompts, granular control, auto-update detection, batch upgrades, and features like cleanup and quarantine bypass, enhancing the efficiency of managing Homebrew Cask applications.

repos.description: Magic auto brightness based on screen contents 💡
repos.summary_zh: Lumen 是一款 macOS 菜单栏应用，能根据屏幕内容自动调节亮度。用户只需使用亮度键即可控制，系统会自动学习偏好。当屏幕显示深色内容（如终端）时自动调亮，显示浅色内容（如网页）时自动调暗，显著提升夜间使用舒适度，尤其适合长时间编程或阅读。
repos.summary_en: Lumen is a macOS menu bar app that automatically adjusts screen brightness based on displayed content. It learns user preferences via brightness keys, brightening the screen for dark content (e.g., terminal) and dimming it for light content (e.g., web pages), offering a more comfortable viewing experience, especially at night.

repos.description: A tab bar that switches between scenes, written in JS for cross-platform support
repos.summary_zh: react-native-tab-navigator 是一个基于 JavaScript 的跨平台标签栏组件，专为 React Native 设计，支持 iOS 和 Android。它允许在多个场景间切换，提供自定义图标、徽章、标题等交互元素，兼容 React Native 0.16+，适用于构建原生级标签导航界面。
repos.summary_en: react-native-tab-navigator is a cross-platform tab bar component written in JavaScript for React Native, supporting iOS and Android. It enables switching between scenes with customizable icons, badges, and titles, compatible with React Native 0.16+. Ideal for building native-like tab navigation interfaces.

repos.description: Desktop app to manage AI coding agent skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex, and 20+ platforms from one place.
repos.summary_zh: skills-manage 是一款基于 Tauri 的桌面应用，统一管理 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 20+ AI 编程工具的技能库。支持中央技能库管理、跨平台安装卸载、GitHub 仓库导入、Obsidian 项目发现及智能搜索等功能，提供 Markdown 预览和 AI 解释生成能力。
repos.summary_en: skills-manage is a Tauri-based desktop app for centralized management of AI coding agent skills across 20+ platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It features a unified skill library, cross-platform symlink installation, GitHub repository import, project-level discovery (including Obsidian vaults), and bilingual UI with Catppuccin themes.

repos.description: ChatMCP is an AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
repos.summary_zh: ChatMCP 是一款跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，完整实现 Model Context Protocol (MCP)，支持 MacOS、Windows、Linux、iOS、Android 和 Web 多端运行。提供本地存储、数据同步、LaTeX 渲染、Mermaid 图表生成、HTML 预览及多 LLM 模型接入等功能，适用于智能对话与工具集成场景。
repos.summary_en: ChatMCP is a cross-platform AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP), supporting MacOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, and Web. It offers local storage, data sync, LaTeX rendering, Mermaid diagram generation, HTML preview, and multi-LLM provider integration for intelligent conversations and tool workflows.

repos.description: Elegant Microsoft To-Do desktop app
repos.summary_zh: Ao 是一款优雅的开源 Microsoft To-Do 桌面应用，支持深色/黑色/琥珀色主题、紧凑模式、全局快捷键、列表导航及跨平台使用，覆盖 120 余国用户，提供高度可定制界面与自动夜间模式，通过 GitHub Sponsors 获得社区支持。
repos.summary_en: Ao is an elegant, unofficial, open-source Microsoft To-Do desktop app used globally, featuring dark themes, compact mode, global shortcuts, list navigation, scalable UI, and auto-night mode, with community-driven development and support via GitHub Sponsors.

repos.description: GitHub notifications alike app for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-notifications 是一个专为 Django 设计的 GitHub 风格通知系统，基于 Activity Streams 规范构建。它通过 Actor、Verb、Action Object 和 Target 四元组模型实现灵活的事件通知机制，支持任意 Django 对象间的关联，适用于构建用户动态、活动提醒等场景。
repos.summary_en: django-notifications is a GitHub-style notification system for Django, built on the Activity Streams specification. It uses a four-component model (Actor, Verb, Action Object, Target) to create flexible event-based notifications, supporting arbitrary Django object relationships for user activity feeds and real-time alerts.

repos.description: Emby Android TV 客户端
repos.summary_zh: ChaiChaiEmbyTV 是一款专为 Android TV 设计的 Emby 客户端，支持原生遥控器操作、弹幕播放、多服务器管理及播放进度同步。采用 Jetpack Compose + Media3 + AkDanmaku 技术栈，提供流畅的电视端观影体验，兼容主流弹幕 API，适合家庭影院场景。
repos.summary_en: ChaiChaiEmbyTV is a native Android TV client for Emby media server, featuring remote-control optimized UI, danmaku support via multiple APIs, multi-server management, and playback progress sync. Built with Jetpack Compose, Media3, and AkDanmaku for smooth TV streaming experience.

repos.description: [GenAI Application Development Framework]  🚀 Build GenAI application quick and easy 💬 Easy to interact with GenAI agent in code using structure data and chained-calls syntax 🧩 Use Event-Driven Flow *TriggerFlow* to manage complex GenAI working logic 🔀 Switch to any model without rewrite application code
repos.summary_zh: Agently 4 是一个生产级 GenAI 应用开发框架，支持结构化数据交互、链式调用语法和事件驱动流（TriggerFlow）编排复杂工作逻辑。它提供契约优先的输出控制、多模型无缝切换能力，并集成会话管理、工具调用与 FastAPI，显著提升 AI 应用的开发效率与稳定性。
repos.summary_en: Agently 4 is a production-grade GenAI application development framework enabling structured data interaction, chained-calls syntax, and event-driven flow orchestration via TriggerFlow. It offers contract-first output control, seamless model switching, session management, tool integration, and FastAPI support to accelerate reliable AI app development.

repos.description: DCloud开源项目集锦
repos.summary_zh: DCloud开源项目合集，涵盖uni-app、uni-app x、uniCloud、UTS等全栈开发框架的示例工程，提供uni-ai x全平台AI聊天套件及uVue语法测试项目，助力开发者快速构建跨平台移动应用与云端一体化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: DCloud's open-source project collection featuring example projects for uni-app, uni-app x, uniCloud, UTS, and more, including the open-source cross-platform AI chat suite uni-ai-x and uVue syntax test project, enabling rapid development of mobile and cloud-integrated applications.

repos.description: A Django app that keeps a log of changes made to an object.
repos.summary_zh: django-auditlog 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，用于自动记录模型对象的所有变更，包括操作用户、变更摘要及详细 JSON 数据，支持灵活查询与审计追踪，适用于需要完整操作日志的场景。
repos.summary_en: django-auditlog is a lightweight Django app that automatically logs all changes to model objects, capturing the actor, change summary, and detailed JSON data for flexible auditing and traceability.

repos.description: Simple prebuilt applications.
repos.summary_zh: Django Basic Apps 是一组预构建的 Django 应用集合，提供博客、媒体内嵌等基础功能模块。支持通过模板标记语法 `<inline type="app.model" id="1"/>` 实现内容内嵌，需依赖 Django Comments、Tagging、Markdown 等第三方库。
repos.summary_en: Django Basic Apps is a collection of prebuilt Django applications offering core features like blogging and content inlining. It supports embedding objects via template markup `<inline type="app.model" id="1"/>` and requires dependencies such as Django Comments, Tagging, and Markdown libraries.

repos.description: A news-reading App (MVP+Dagger2+RxJava+Retrofit2+Material Design)
repos.summary_zh: ColorfulNews 是一款基于 MVP 架构的新闻阅读应用，采用 Material Design 风格，集成 Dagger2、RxJava 和 Retrofit2 实现高效的数据绑定与网络请求。支持多频道浏览、图片新闻展示及流畅交互体验，适用于 Android 平台学习与实践。
repos.summary_en: ColorfulNews is a news-reading app built with MVP architecture and Material Design, utilizing Dagger2, RxJava, and Retrofit2 for robust dependency injection, reactive programming, and network communication. It supports multi-channel browsing, image news display, and smooth user interactions, ideal for Android development learning.

repos.description: Material Design 中文版 ( 2015 年 8 月更新)
repos.summary_zh: Material Design 中文版是 Google 官方设计规范的首个完整中文翻译项目，由 1sters 团队联合极客学院于 2015 年 8 月完成全面更新。该项目系统性地将 Material Design 核心理念、组件规范与交互原则转化为高质量中文文档，覆盖 60+ 章节，极大推动了中国开发者对现代移动 UI 设计的理解与实践。
repos.summary_en: Material Design 中文版 is the first complete Chinese translation of Google's official design specification, collaboratively completed by the 1sters team and Geekbang Academy in August 2015. This project systematically translates core concepts, component specifications, and interaction principles of Material Design into high-quality documentation, covering over 60 chapters, significantly advancing the understanding and practice of modern mobile UI design among Chinese developers.

repos.description: 一款白噪音应用送给你，祝您牛掰，有的是钱
repos.summary_zh: XMSLEEP 是一款专注于白噪音播放的 Android 应用，提供雨声、篝火、雷声等多种自然声音，支持音量调节、倒计时、预设播放区域及收藏功能。采用 Material Design 3 和 Jetpack Compose 构建，具备深色模式、动态主题色、无缝循环播放及蓝牙耳机支持，界面简洁流畅，适用于放松、专注和助眠场景。
repos.summary_en: XMSLEEP is an Android app focused on white noise playback, offering natural sounds like rain, fire, thunder, and bird chirps. It supports volume control, countdown timer, preset playlists, favorites, and seamless looping. Built with Jetpack Compose and Material Design 3, it features dark mode, dynamic theming, Coil image loading, and Bluetooth headset support for immersive relaxation, focus, and sleep aid.

repos.description: Surge模块 脚本 module sgmodule 面板 规则 分流 破解 解锁
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Surge 模块脚本集合，涵盖去广告、应用解锁、会员功能激活等实用功能，支持哔哩哔哩高清、彩云天气 SVIP、扫描全能王会员等多种主流 App，适用于 iOS 平台网络流量管理与自动化增强。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a collection of Surge modules for ad removal, app unlocking, and premium feature activation, supporting popular apps like Bilibili HD, Caiyun Weather SVIP, and CamScanner. Designed for iOS network traffic management and automation enhancement.

repos.description: A simple android app to enable Google Location Report, Google Now and related functions in China mainland or somewhere like.
repos.summary_zh: LocationReportEnabler 是一款专为中国大陆用户设计的 Android 应用，通过修改系统参数启用 Google 位置报告、Google Now 及相关功能。支持 ROOT 和 Xposed 框架两种模式，后者更稳定。核心功能包括设置运营商代码和 ISO 国家代码，以绕过地理限制，恢复 Google 服务的时间线功能。
repos.summary_en: LocationReportEnabler is a simple Android app designed to enable Google Location Report, Google Now, and related features in mainland China. It works by setting system properties like gsm.sim.operator.numeric and iso-country to bypass regional restrictions. Available in ROOT and Xposed variants, with the latter recommended for better stability and clarity.

repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Next.js 的对话型 Web 应用模板，专为集成 Dify AI 平台设计。支持通过环境变量配置 APP ID、API Key 和接口地址，提供 Docker 部署方案，具备多语言支持和自定义提示词功能，适用于快速构建企业级智能对话界面。
repos.summary_en: This is a Next.js-based conversational web app template designed for Dify AI platform integration. It supports configuration via environment variables (APP ID, API Key, URL), offers Docker deployment, multi-language support, and customizable prompts, enabling rapid development of enterprise-grade AI chat interfaces.

repos.description: :collision::collision::collision:【Flutter版】玩安卓，非常适合学习，代码不多、注释多。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Flutter 开发的玩安卓客户端应用，代码简洁、注释详尽，非常适合 Flutter 初学者学习。项目完整实现了登录注册、首页列表、搜索、侧边栏、WebView 加载、主题切换、状态管理等功能，涵盖常用 UI 组件和状态管理方案，并提供多平台截图与 APK 下载。
repos.summary_en: This is a WanAndroid client app built with Flutter, featuring clean code and extensive comments, ideal for Flutter beginners. It implements core features like login, homepage, search, sidebar, WebView, theme switching, and state management, covering essential UI components and state management patterns, with multi-platform screenshots and APK available.

repos.description: Lumina Note - A modern Markdown note-taking app with live preview, bidirectional links, and AI assistant
repos.summary_zh: Lumina Note 是一款本地优先的 AI 笔记应用，支持 Markdown 实时预览、双向链接（WikiLinks）和知识图谱可视化。集成多模态 AI 助手（Chat/Agent/Deep Research/Codex），提供本地语义检索（RAG）功能，确保数据完全掌控于用户手中。
repos.summary_en: Lumina Note is a local-first AI note-taking app featuring live Markdown preview, bidirectional links, and knowledge graph visualization. It integrates multimodal AI assistants (Chat/Agent/Deep Research/Codex) with local RAG retrieval, ensuring full data ownership and privacy.

repos.description: RN 开源之初，写几个Mini-App
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是React Native早期实战项目集合，包含通讯录、LBS附近服务、豆瓣API搜索等Mini-App。涵盖文件系统Node.js服务端、通讯录管理、公告系统、地图定位及Webview集成，提供完整移动端开发范例，适合RN初学者学习全栈移动应用开发。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains early React Native practical projects including address book, LBS nearby services, and Douban API search apps. It covers Node.js file-based backend, contact management, announcements, map positioning, and Webview integration, serving as a comprehensive full-stack mobile development tutorial for RN beginners.

repos.description: 基于 SwiftUI + AppKit 构建、由 mihomo 驱动的原生 macOS 菜单栏代理客户端，专注轻量、稳定与可观测。
repos.summary_zh: ClashBar 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏代理客户端，基于 mihomo Core，采用 SwiftUI + AppKit 构建。主打轻量化设计（37.5MB），支持配置管理、节点切换、流量策略控制、实时连接监控与系统代理集成，提供中英文双语界面，专注提升代理工具在 macOS 上的易用性与稳定性。
repos.summary_en: ClashBar is a native macOS menu bar proxy client built with SwiftUI + AppKit, powered by mihomo Core. It emphasizes lightweight design (37.5MB), offering configuration management, node switching, traffic policy control, real-time connection monitoring, and system proxy integration. With bilingual support (zh/en), it enhances usability and stability for proxy tools on macOS.

repos.description: 移动端响应式插件
repos.summary_zh: 移动端响应式插件通过transform:scale实现页面缩放适配，支持contain/cover/auto三种模式，兼容iOS4+与Android2.3+等老旧系统。采用视觉稿px单位直接适配，无需rem或媒体查询，零依赖仅1KB，适合单屏滑屏H5页面开发。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight mobile responsive plugin using transform:scale for device adaptation. Supports contain/cover/auto modes with excellent legacy browser support (iOS4+/Android2.3+). Uses visual design px units directly without rem or media queries, ideal for single-screen H5 apps.

repos.description: HiApp written in react-native.
repos.summary_zh: HiApp 是一款基于 React Native 开发的跨平台移动应用，支持 iOS 和 Android 平台。项目提供完整的开发环境配置指南，包含依赖安装、打包器启动及真机运行方案，适合学习 React Native 开发实践。
repos.summary_en: HiApp is a cross-platform mobile application built with React Native, supporting both iOS and Android. It includes setup instructions for dependency installation, packager startup, and device deployment, serving as a practical reference for React Native development.

repos.description: The unofficial V2EX app for iOS
repos.summary_zh: darkerk/v2ex 是一款专为 iOS 平台开发的非官方 V2EX 客户端应用，采用 Swift 4.1 编写，支持 iOS 10.0+。该应用提供简洁的界面设计，让用户能够便捷地浏览 V2EX 社区内容，包括节点、主题和评论等核心功能，是 V2EX 用户的移动端优质替代方案。
repos.summary_en: darkerk/v2ex is an unofficial iOS app for V2EX, built with Swift 4.1 and compatible with iOS 10.0+. It offers a clean interface for browsing V2EX content, including nodes, topics, and comments, serving as a convenient mobile alternative to the web version of V2EX.

repos.description: 爱V2EX（原掌上V2EX）
repos.summary_zh: 爱V2EX是一款非官方的V2EX社区Android客户端，提供话题浏览、节点搜索、用户资料查看、话题创建与回复、未读提醒等功能，支持滑动手势操作，界面简洁易用，完全开源并遵循GPL协议。
repos.summary_en: V2EX-android is a non-official Android client for the V2EX community, offering features like topic browsing, node search, user profiles, topic creation/replies, and unread notifications. It supports gesture navigation and is fully open-source under the GPL license.

repos.description: 针对 Vue 框架移植的 We UI 框架的适配，让 mobile开发过程成为一种享受。 Demo:
repos.summary_zh: vue-weui 是将 WeUI 移动端 UI 框架适配到 Vue.js 的项目，结合 vue-router、ES6 和 Webpack 构建现代化移动应用开发环境，提供开箱即用的组件库和开发工具链，显著提升移动端开发效率与体验。
repos.summary_en: vue-weui is a Vue.js adaptation of the WeUI mobile UI framework, integrating vue-router, ES6, and Webpack to deliver a modern development stack for mobile apps. It offers ready-to-use components and tooling to streamline mobile development.

repos.description: A v2ex client on android platform.(deprecated)
repos.summary_zh: v2ex-daily-android 是一款已停止维护的 Android 客户端应用，专为访问 v2ex 社区设计，支持浏览主题、节点搜索和用户信息查看，界面遵循 Material Design 风格，提供简洁高效的原生体验。
repos.summary_en: v2ex-daily-android is a deprecated Android client for the v2ex community, offering topic browsing, node search, and user profiles with a clean Material Design interface, optimized for native mobile experience.

repos.description: (Deprecated) WeUI Components with love of vue.js
repos.summary_zh: vue-weui 是一个已停止维护的 Vue 组件库，封装了 WeUI 0.4.0+ 的微信风格 UI 组件，完全解耦 CSS 样式，支持按需引入以优化包体积，适用于移动端 Web 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-weui is a deprecated Vue component library that encapsulates WeUI 0.4.0+ components for WeChat Web apps. It decouples CSS for full customization and supports selective imports to minimize bundle size.

repos.description: Douban Search App Based on React Native
repos.summary_zh: React-Dou 是基于 React Native 和豆瓣开放 API 开发的跨平台搜索应用，支持图书、音乐、电影三大类内容的搜索、列表展示与详情查看，具备完整的移动端交互体验，适用于快速构建豆瓣生态相关的数据检索工具。
repos.summary_en: React-Dou is a cross-platform search app built with React Native and Douban Open API, supporting search, listing, and detail views for books, music, and movies. It delivers a complete mobile experience for accessing Douban's content ecosystem.

repos.description: Urban governance - Where is the restroom?
repos.summary_zh: 该应用为解决城市如厕难问题，提供附近2公里内卫生间实时搜索、导航及基础信息查询，集成地图、天气、文章推荐等功能，采用高德地图、七牛云存储、微信公众号及阿里云部署，展示如何快速构建实用型移动应用。
repos.summary_en: This app addresses urban restroom accessibility by enabling users to search nearby toilets within 2km, view basic info, and get navigation. It integrates map services, weather, articles, and uses platforms like Amap, Qiniu Cloud, WeChat, and Aliyun for rapid deployment of a practical mobile solution.

repos.description: Think of it as flatpages for small bits of reusable content you might want to insert into your templates and manage from the admin interface.
repos.summary_zh: django-chunks 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，提供类似 flatpages 的可复用内容块管理功能。通过简单的模型和模板标签，开发者可在后台管理界面创建命名内容块（如 'home_page_left'），并在模板中动态插入，支持富文本编辑，适用于需要多区域内容管理的场景。
repos.summary_en: django-chunks is a lightweight Django app that enables reusable content blocks similar to flatpages. It provides a model and template tag to manage named content chunks via the admin interface, allowing dynamic insertion into templates with rich text editing support—ideal for sites requiring multiple editable content areas.

repos.description: 📚《Flutter 入门指南》
repos.summary_zh: 《Flutter 入门指南》是一本系统介绍 Flutter 跨平台开发框架的电子书，涵盖 Dart 语言、Skia 图形引擎及 Material Design UI 开发。适合有 JavaScript 基础的前端开发者快速掌握移动端、Web 和桌面端应用开发技能。
repos.summary_en: 《Flutter 入门指南》is a comprehensive guide to Flutter, covering Dart language, Skia graphics engine, and Material Design UI development for cross-platform apps (mobile, web, desktop). Ideal for frontend developers with JavaScript background.

repos.description: 自用tvbox配置
repos.summary_zh: Meow 是一个自用 TVBox 配置项目，提供完整的配置文件 meow.json 及安卓客户端 Tvbox-xxx.apk。支持多站点源管理，部分站点标记为不支持搜索，需手动设置为源使用，适合个人影音资源自动化播放场景。
repos.summary_en: Meow is a personal-use TVBox configuration project offering a complete config file (meow.json) and Android client (Tvbox-xxx.apk). It supports multi-site source management, with some sites marked as non-searchable requiring manual source setup, ideal for automated media playback.

repos.description: A django app that provides Markdown-related template tags using the python-markdown2 library.
repos.summary_zh: django-markdown-deux 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，基于 python-markdown2 库提供 Markdown 模板标签支持。它允许在 Django 模板中通过 `markdown` 过滤器或块标签渲染 Markdown 内容，并支持自定义样式配置，适用于需要统一 Markdown 渲染选项的场景。
repos.summary_en: django-markdown-deux is a lightweight Django app that provides Markdown template tags using the python-markdown2 library. It enables rendering Markdown in Django templates via the `markdown` filter or block tag, with support for customizable styles via configuration, ideal for consistent Markdown processing across templates.

repos.description: Clash X
repos.summary_zh: ClashX 是一款基于 Clash 的 macOS 代理客户端，专为 macOS 15+ (Sequoia) 优化，支持 HTTP/HTTPS、SOCKS 协议及 Vmess/Shadowsocks/Trojan 等多种代理协议。提供直观的图形界面与 Surge 风格配置，集成 GeoIP 规则、Netfilter TCP 重定向等功能，适用于高级网络代理需求。
repos.summary_en: ClashX is a rule-based proxy client for macOS built on Clash, optimized for macOS 15+ (Sequoia). It supports HTTP/HTTPS, SOCKS protocols and multiple proxy types including Vmess, Shadowsocks, and Trojan. Features intuitive UI, Surge-like configuration, GeoIP rules, Netfilter TCP redirection, and advanced scripting capabilities.

repos.description: 🚀 UniHub - 现代化的跨平台工具集应用，支持强大的插件系统 | Modern cross-platform toolkit with powerful plugin system
repos.summary_zh: UniHub 是基于 Electron 的现代化跨平台工具集应用，采用 Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite 技术栈，配备强大的插件系统和内置插件市场。支持动态插件加载、细粒度权限管理、自动更新检测等功能，提供优雅的 Tailwind CSS 界面和全局快捷键操作体验。
repos.summary_en: UniHub is a modern cross-platform toolkit built with Electron, Vue 3, TypeScript, and Vite. It features a powerful plugin system with dynamic loading, granular permission control, built-in marketplace, and automatic update detection. The app offers an elegant UI powered by Tailwind CSS and global keyboard shortcuts for enhanced productivity.

repos.description: Android Client for Carbon Forum with Material Design.
repos.summary_zh: Android-Carbon-Forum 是一个基于 Material Design 的 Carbon Forum 论坛 Android 客户端，提供流畅的移动端浏览体验，支持主题查看、发帖、登录、通知推送等功能，采用模块化架构便于二次开发和定制部署。
repos.summary_en: Android-Carbon-Forum is an Android client for Carbon Forum built with Material Design, offering seamless mobile browsing, topic viewing, posting, login, and push notifications. It features a modular architecture for easy customization and deployment.

repos.description: Open-source Android vault app to hide photos, videos, audio, notes & documents securely with AES encryption

repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: notion客户端汉化，包括mac和win
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为Notion桌面客户端（v3.1.0）提供完整汉化支持，涵盖Windows与macOS系统。通过替换`app.asar`文件实现界面本地化，保留原有功能的同时提升中文用户体验，适用于需要中文界面的Notion用户。
repos.summary_en: This project provides full Chinese localization for Notion desktop client (v3.1.0), supporting both Windows and macOS. By replacing the `app.asar` file, it enables native Chinese UI while preserving all original functionality, ideal for users requiring a localized interface.

repos.description: A simple django app to use emojis on your website ⛺
repos.summary_zh: django-emoji 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，用于在网站中便捷地渲染表情符号。它支持将文本中的 :emoji: 标记自动转换为 Unicode 字符或图片，并提供 HTML 实体转换功能，适用于提升用户交互体验的 Web 项目。
repos.summary_en: django-emoji is a lightweight Django app that enables easy emoji rendering on websites. It automatically converts :emoji: text patterns into Unicode or image tags, with support for HTML entity conversion, ideal for enhancing user engagement in web applications.

repos.description: A Django app for unified and persistent user messages/notifications, built on top of Django's messages framework
repos.summary_zh: Django Persistent Messages 是一个基于 Django 消息框架的扩展应用，提供持久化用户消息/通知功能。支持认证用户将消息存储在数据库中，实现跨会话的‘粘性’提醒，直到用户标记为已读。未认证用户仍使用会话存储。统一 API 支持屏幕显示和邮件通知，兼容 Django 原生消息系统。
repos.summary_en: Django Persistent Messages is a Django app extending the built-in messages framework to support persistent user notifications. It stores messages in the database for authenticated users, enabling sticky reminders until marked read. Anonymous users use session storage. Offers unified API for display and email notifications, fully compatible with Django's native messaging system.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供经过筛选的高质量影视接口，包含单仓优选和多仓聚合方案，支持主流网盘下载TVBox及宝盒等第三方影视应用。所有接口内容均来自网络公开资源，仅供自用测试，强调版权合规与来源标注要求。
repos.summary_en: This project offers high-quality streaming interfaces, including single-source optimized and multi-source aggregated APIs, supporting downloads of TVBox and third-party apps via mainstream cloud storage. All content is sourced from public networks for personal use only, with strict copyright compliance and attribution requirements.

repos.description: My independent fork of django-persistent-messages. A Django app for unified and persistent user messages/notifications, built on top of Django's messages framework
repos.summary_zh: django-persistent-messages 是一个基于 Django 消息框架的扩展应用，为认证用户提供持久化消息存储，支持消息标记已读、删除和回复，同时为匿名用户保留会话级消息功能，实现统一的消息管理接口。
repos.summary_en: Django Persistent Messages extends Django's messaging framework to provide persistent message storage for authenticated users via database, with features like mark-as-read, delete, and reply. Anonymous users retain session-based messages. Offers a unified API combining persistent and temporary messaging.

repos.description: MOVED TO https://github.com/jezdez/django-avatar
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库已迁移至新地址，原项目不再维护。新的 django-avatar 项目由 jezdez 维护，提供 Django 应用的用户头像管理功能，支持图片上传、裁剪和显示，适用于需要用户头像功能的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: This repository is outdated - the new one is at https://github.com/jezdez/django-avatar. The new django-avatar project by jezdez provides user avatar management for Django apps, supporting image upload, cropping, and display for web applications requiring user profile pictures.

repos.description: A reusable django application for handling Avatars.
repos.summary_zh: django-simple-avatar 是一个可复用的 Django 应用，用于处理用户头像。支持默认使用 Gravatar 作为头像，自动生缩略图并存储至默认文件存储后端，简化头像管理流程。
repos.summary_en: django-simple-avatar is a reusable Django app for handling user avatars. It supports default Gravatar fallback, automatically generates thumbnails, and stores them in the default file storage backend for efficient retrieval.

repos.description: Integrate awesome Bleach library into Django
repos.summary_zh: django-bleach 是一个 Django 应用，用于将 Bleach 库集成到项目中，实现对用户提交的 HTML 内容进行安全过滤和净化。它提供模型字段、表单字段和模板过滤器三种使用方式，支持自定义允许的标签、属性和样式，防止 XSS 攻击，适用于需要富文本输入的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-bleach is a Django app that integrates the Bleach library to sanitize user-submitted HTML content. It offers model fields, form fields, and template filters for safe HTML processing, with customizable allowed tags, attributes, and styles to prevent XSS attacks in web applications requiring rich text input.

repos.description: 利用reactnative技术，开发，生成app
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 React Native 开发的移动端应用 demo，参考淘宝手机端 UI 设计，实现了包含首页、微淘、社区、购物车、个人中心等模块的 TabBar 界面。支持图标切换、角标提醒等功能，展示了 React Native 在跨平台 App 开发中的高效性和前端开发者上手友好的特点。
repos.summary_en: This project is a React Native-based mobile app demo, inspired by Taobao's mobile interface. It features a TabBar with modules like Home, Weitao, Community, Cart, and Profile, supporting icon switching and badge notifications. It demonstrates React Native's efficiency in cross-platform development and ease of use for frontend developers.
